item.description: NORFOLK, Va. (WAVY) -- Mayor Kenny Alexander has been appointed the interim president of Richard Bland College in Petersburg. item.title: Report: Norfolk, Portsmouth prosecutors among coalition to fight federal overreach
item.description: NORFOLK, Va. (WAVY) — Norfolk Commonwealth's Attorney Ramin Fatehi said he is among a newly-formed coalition of prosecutors who are fighting back against what they say is federal overreach. Fatehi made the announcement during an NAACP vigil and call-to-action town hall in Hampton Tuesday to remember the two people killed by federal agents in Minneapolis [...]

item.title: Grieving father prepares for trial of 2 men accused of killing son
item.description: HAMPTON, Va. (WAVY) — A grieving father is preparing for the trial of two men accused of killing his son. Martez Corey, 26, was gunned down June 1, 2024 on Old Buckroe Road in Hampton as he sat on the porch, the bullet holes still visible on the side of the house. item.title: Virginia State Police issues alert for missing Chesapeake man
item.description: Virginia State Police issued a critically missing adult alert Wednesday around 5:30 p.m. on behalf of the Chesapeake Police Department for a man whose disappearance poses a credible threat to his health and safety.

item.title: The Boodah Brothers of radio station 103 JAMZ are together again. Big B died at the age of 57
item.description: 57-year old Chris Belcher, known as Big B from Radio Station 103 Jamz, died Monday, after suffering from multiple health conditions, a family spokesperson confirmed to WAVY.

item.title: YPSO: Police shoot, kill suspect in stabbing outside York County store
item.description: A woman was stabbed outside a Ross Dress for Less store on Mooretown Road and a suspect was shot and killed by police inside a nearby Home Depot Wednesday, the York-Poquoson Sheriff's Office said. The woman who was stabbed has non life-threatening injuries, according to the sheriff's office.
